bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 166, Number 203 (Wednesday, December 2, 2020)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. COMER:
H.R. 8832.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
article I, section 8, clauses 1, 3, 9, and 18, and article
III, section 2, clause 1 of the Constitution of the United
States.
[Page H6046]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on the Judiciary, and in addition to the Committees on Education and Labor, and Energy and Commerce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
